bottleneck.identified: Notion sync discipline — last-mile delivery gap
bottleneck.evidence: Dashboard and GitHub Pages are now clean and current. The persistent gap is Notion. MORNING_BRIEFING_2026-03-31.pdf exists but isn't in TJ's Notion. New hubs (Mother's Day, Easter) have no PDF versions and no Notion presence. The pattern: content gets created and committed but the Notion upload step gets skipped. TJ finds things on the dashboard but not in Notion when he wants offline reference.
bottleneck.recommendation: Every content-generating workflow needs a mandatory Notion upload step at the end — not optional, not 'when Franklin has time.' This is the compounding reliability gap preventing full trust in the system.

compoundingImprovement.suggestion: Build a post-commit hook or checklist that auto-triggers the Notion upload step. Alternatively: add a 'Notion Sync Status' column to FRANKLINS_WORK_LOG.md — any row without ✅ in the Notion column is an open action item that Chief flags each cycle. Two mechanisms: (1) work log tracks sync status, (2) Chief audits the log. This prevents the silent gap where content exists on GitHub but not in Notion.
compoundingImprovement.effort: Low — 15 min to update FRANKLINS_WORK_LOG.md template + add Chief check
compoundingImprovement.compoundingMechanism: Every future deliverable gets a Notion sync checkbox. Chief audits it. Gap rate goes to near-zero. One-time build, perpetual accountability.
